chunks: Aḥmad ibn Abī ʿAbdillāh, from ʿUthmān ibn ʿĪsā, from Samāʿah, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
“The slave is killed in retaliation for the free person, but the free person is not killed for the slave; rather, he is made to pay his price and is beaten severely so that he does not return to it.”

key_terms.يُقْتَلُ: is put to death in legal retaliation

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on retaliation when a free person kills a slave or a slave kills a free person in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning qisas between a slave and a free person. It establishes that a slave may be executed in retaliation for killing a free person, whereas a free person is not executed for killing a slave, but must pay the slave’s value and receive a severe disciplinary beating.
